import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When('I submit token {string}', function (token: string) {
  const statuses = { expired: 401, current: 200 };
  this.response = {
    status:
      process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT === '1'
        ? (token === 'expired' ? 200 : 401)
        : statuses[token as keyof typeof statuses],
  };
});
Then('the response status is {int}', function (status: number) {
  assert.equal(this.response.status, status);
});
